hook: Smith turned a $600K loss into an $8 million profit at Piston Group inside a single year, then spent two decades repeating that pattern of operational turnarounds across automotive and manufacturing suppliers ranging from $120 million to over $1 billion in revenue. He now sits on the board of Nikola Motor Company, the autonomous and electric truck maker, while running his own holding company, Voltava.
name: Bruce Smith

quote.text: Turned $600K loss into $8 million in profit within a year.
quote.context: Bruce Smith, LinkedIn profile, summarising his tenure as CEO of Piston Group

moniker: Owner, Chairman and CEO, Voltava; Nikola Motor Company board member

timeline.event: Director of Manufacturing, West Region, American National Can
timeline.impact: Runs six plants and 600 employees on $500M+ in annual sales; improves operating income by more than $10 million annually through TPM, Kanban and mistake-proofing

timeline.event: Chief Operating Officer, United Plastics Group
timeline.impact: Improves EBITDA by 300 percent on a $270M, 2,300-employee global injection molding business while sales dropped over 10 percent
Turns $600K net loss into $8 million profit in one year; secures $320M in new business, doubling company size within 18 months
Leads worldwide operations of a $475M Cerberus Capital automotive-interiors portfolio company; triples EBITDA to 10 percent of sales

timeline.event: President and CEO, Elyria & Hodge Foundries
timeline.impact: Leads a $120M privately held castings supplier; increases sales and EBITDA by 51 and over 100 percent respectively, adding roughly $70M in enterprise value
Runs a global supplier of clinching tools and automated assembly systems headquartered in Marysville, Michigan

timeline.event: Owner, Chairman and CEO, Detroit Manufacturing Systems
timeline.impact: Leads a purpose-driven $1 billion vertically integrated value-add assembler in Detroit
Serves over five years on the board of the autonomous and electric truck maker
Founds and leads a new holding company based in Auburn Hills, Michigan

quick_facts: Increased EBITDA by more than $32 million at Elyria & Hodge Foundries, over 3x the historical average
Grew Piston Group by $320 million in new business awards, doubling the company in 18 months
MBA, Harvard Business School; BS in Mechanical Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University
Currently owns and chairs Voltava after leading Detroit Manufacturing Systems, a $1 billion assembler, for over seven years
